card.name: The word day after per or a
card.fires_on: The word "day" (or "/day", "BID") ending a per-day dose rate, right after "a" or "per" following an amount in dosing instructions.

modes.label: a/per day
modes.description: "day" closing a dose rate after "a" or "per" following a quantity.
modes.example: The dosage may be increased to 2 tablets a<< day>>, if necessary.

modes.label: Daily-rate abbreviations
modes.description: Short forms such as BID or /day that express a frequency or rate per day.
modes.example: then may resume Zydelig at 100 mg B<<ID>>.

card.writes: It pushes toward rate and frequency words like rate, pace, daily and weekly, which fits the end of a per-time-unit phrase.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "day" when a dose is given as an amount per day.
